Liangjia Sports Technology (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. was established in Shanghai in 2018 and relocated to Guangzhou in 2020.   It is a high-tech enterprise engaged in the research and development, production and sales of digital intelligent sports, our main products are simulators of kinds of sports,such as tennis, baseball, badminton, table tennis, football, skiing and other dozens of domestic initiatives, independent research and development of intelligent digital sports products.


our company has a variety of product core technology, professional core R & D team,  leading the domestic counterparts in the field of technology, there are rich diversified intelligent sports technology products, and actively create more independent brands, excellent service quality, professional and safe technical service strength, Continuously innovate and improve the after-sales system to provide higher and better services for users in different fields.


In addition, our company provides customers with equipment installation, one-stop services including store opening support (such as site selection planning and design, new media promotion and operation and after-sales service) to ensure that customers can enter the market and operate quickly and efficiently.


Our products have obtained national intellectual property protection and various certifications, have a complete intellectual property system and certification system, and have won various representative awards in the industry.
